title: Molex Shoora Font Family Display
coreRelationships: The large yellow 'Molex Shoora' text is the central focal point, drawing immediate attention.
The white text elements provide contrast and additional information, framing the central yellow text.
The yellow sunburst icons act as decorative accents and visual anchors at the corners.
The vertical text elements on the sides create a sense of enclosure and dynamic balance.
The black background provides a stark contrast, making the yellow and white text pop.
reuseFormula: Create a black rectangular canvas. Place a large, decorative, and bold font name in a bright, saturated yellow in the center. Frame this central text with smaller informational text in both white and the same yellow, some oriented horizontally and some vertically. Add four symmetrical decorative icons (e.g., sunbursts) in the same bright yellow at the corners of the central text block. Ensure ample negative space for clarity.

Do not add any text or graphic elements at this stage. · Overlay the background with the following typographic elements: 1. A large, bold, high-contrast display serif in yellow for the primary central text, with tight tracking and leading. 2. A lighter, fluid, decorative sans-serif in white for the framing text at the top and bottom, with normal tracking. 3. The same display serif, in white, rotated 90 degrees clockwise and set vertically with loose tracking, for the left and right framing elements. 4. Smaller instances of the decorative sans-serif in yellow for corner metadata. 5. Place stylized sunburst/starburst icons in yellow as decorative separators and accents, ensuring they are visually balanced with the text. · Are the two primary typefaces distinctly different in style and weight? · Is the main display text visually dominant and central? · Are the framing texts clearly secondary but still decorative? · Is the color contrast between text and background strong and legible? · Are the decorative elements (sunbursts, vertical text) integrated harmoniously? · high
